name: three guards are hired to one guard post, a watch each, and keep it round the clock

steps.note: a gatehouse laid out like a district's gate: two door leaves in the west wall at (0, 3) and (0, 4), the guard post set into the wall at (0, 1) with a cell of wall between, so its guard stands at (1, 1). Three beds by the east wall. A world opens at 08:00 on day 1, a Monday
one post is three workplaces: the day, the evening and the night watch, handed out in that order

steps.expect_log: was hired as a guard at the guard post at 0, 1, 08:00-16:00
was hired as a guard at the guard post at 0, 1, 16:00-24:00
was hired as a guard at the guard post at 0, 1, 00:00-08:00

steps.note: every need but tiredness switched off, so this is a test about the watches and when each guard sleeps
the day watch is due already: twenty world minutes on it is at the post

steps.expect_text: keep watch at the guard post at 0, 1

steps.note: on watch it is in the guard's uniform; the clothing menu says so, and what it goes home in

steps.shot: twenty past eight: the day watch at the post, the other two in bed or about

steps.note: an hour at the post is an hour kept

steps.expect_log: kept watch an hour at the guard post at 0, 1

steps.note: half past four: the evening watch has taken over and the day watch is done

steps.shot: half past four: the evening watch at the post

steps.note: half past midnight: the night watch, which slept the afternoon, is at the post

steps.shot: half past midnight: the night watch at the post
